## The Gutenberg–Richter law

The number $N$ of earthquakes of magnitude $M$ or more follows

$$\log_{10} N(\ge M) = a - bM$$

with $b$ about 1. The maximum-likelihood estimate (Aki 1965, Utsu 1966) is

$$b = \frac{\log_{10} e}{\bar M - (M_c - \Delta M/2)}$$

Change the band of latitude of **section** or $M_c$ of **b_value** and rerun just that Card.
